title: {{NAME}} and the Robot Who Learned to Be Gentle
moral: Being gentle and slow means you never hurt the ones you love.

pages.content: {{NAME}} lived near a big green field. Many animals played there every day. One morning, a little blue robot walked into the field. The animals had never seen a robot before. They looked very surprised.

pages.content: The robot was called Beep. Beep wanted to play with the animals. But Beep moved too fast and too loud. The animals ran away. Beep's little light on his chest went dim. He was sad.

pages.content: {{NAME}} had an idea. He took Beep's metal hand. He showed Beep how to walk slowly. He showed Beep how to make a soft, quiet sound. Beep tried very hard.

pages.content: Beep made new friends that day. He played gently with every animal. Being gentle and slow means you never hurt the ones you love. Goodnight, {{NAME}}. Sleep well. Beep whispered that he had a secret button on his back. What do you think it does?
